segments.summary: Reviewed the canonical naming and metadata contract, action-surface authority, development-only controls, route/open normalization and failure behavior, stale-canon retirement, owner/consumer gaps, wiring oracles, GitHub auth, project, and File Manager command rows. Exact requirements are strong on stable identity and fail-closed routing; adversarial review found a command_kind versus command_type envelope conflict and preserved cross-document readiness blockers.

Reviewed File Manager, LSP, widget, Run Graph, Orchestrator, external-system namespace, Source Control review/conflict, and GitHub Actions rows. Exact behavior includes closed file-open targets, route-owned pivots, visible disabled reasons, and uncertainty labels; adversarial review found missing LSP mutation outcomes, widget reset recovery, contradictory Actions namespace ownership, duplicate tables, and pseudo-family tokens in command-ID columns.

Reviewed Docker, Kubernetes, project and chat worktree, chat lifecycle, Context Lens, browser preview/capture/takeover, and terminal command ownership. Exact behavior strongly scopes infrastructure approvals, worktree lineage, context-history preservation, browser share versus capture, and terminal action identity; adversarial review found incomplete destructive Docker and Kubernetes recovery, inconsistent worktree confirmation, and missing browser-capture privacy lifecycle.

Reviewed terminal continuity, dev and catalog lifecycle, chat message actions, Debug bridge, reserved slash/web routing, Goal Mode, memory maintenance, artifacts, Search, runtime recovery, and owner mapping. Exact behavior locks terminal reuse, rewind/revert separation, dispatcher parity, owner seams, snapshot-bound replace, and fail-closed runtime identity; adversarial review found missing catalog failure states, under-keyed code-block mutation, unnamed adversarial URL safety, memory disposition gaps, replace-all partial failure, and absent skip/abort safety metadata.

Which owner defines transactional failure, rollback, and receipt semantics for LSP edits, Kubernetes apply or Helm install, catalog lifecycle mutations, and Search replace-all?
Which owner defines redaction, retention, audience, and deletion for browser capture artifacts and assistant-memory discard or prune operations?
Where are confirmation_strength and reversibility fixed for worktree remove or prune or reuse, Docker removal or cleanup, runtime skip_node, and abort_run?
